title: The Wolf Menace
description:
The wolves above Moonhaven have started hunting in formation, which wolves do not do.
Cull {amount} of them and Wolfie will tell you why it frightens him.

title: Potion Delivery
description: Eldrin the Merchant asked you to deliver {amount} Healing Potions to Mira the Innkeeper.

title: Into the Depths
description: Explore the first level of the dungeon and return safely.

title: Skeleton Menace
description: Undead skeletons have been rising near the old burial grounds. Kill {amount} of them.

title: The Rising Tide
description: The beaches of Lirandel are overrun with Corrupted Crabs. Kill {amount} of them to protect the island.

title: Moonbloom for the Sick
description: Healer Mira needs {amount} Moonbloom Herbs to cure the sick villagers. Collect them from the wild.

title: Trial by Storm
description: The court mage demands proof of your mettle. Slay {amount} enemies and return to claim the secrets of the storm.

title: Rite of Blessing
description: The high cleric asks you to prove your faith by destroying {amount} Skeletons that defile the sacred grounds.

title: Purge the Dreamwake Caverns
description: Descend into the Dreamwake Caverns and destroy {amount} Corrupted Shrines that taint the island.

title: The Waterfall Haunting
description: A restless spirit haunts the hidden cave behind the waterfall. She lost her silver locket to the creatures in the dungeon below. Find it and return it to her so she may rest.

title: The Alchemist's Stone
description: Aldric the Alchemist needs a Mooncrest Stone from Lyren the Pale in Mooncrest. Lyren has agreed to hand it over.

title: Find the Hermit
description: Aldric the Alchemist in Moonhaven needs you to find Lyren the Pale, a recluse who lives in Mooncrest. Speak with him.

title: Mazzy's Ring
description: Deliver the ring to Frederick in Mooncrest to let him know you found Mazzy.

title: Cleanse the Temple Grounds
description: Sister Caela senses dark energy seeping into the temple from below. Slay {amount} skeletons to purify the area.

title: Rook's Shadow Errand
description:
Rook wants a Veil Shard: a splinter of the barrier the gods see through, which is exactly the barrier you do not show up behind.
Verath the Blind keeps one in the eastern ruins. Bring it back to Rook in Mooncrest.

title: The Shard of Ambition
description: A faction war simmers on the Forged Isles. Choose a side: help Maren smuggle refugees to safety, or help Emberpriest Cael shut down the smuggling operation.

title: The Missing Forger
description: Forgemaster Kira's best apprentice Aldric has vanished. Ask around — Old Soot in Ashfen Village might know something.

title: The Crucible Trial
description: Pyralis demands proof of your strength. Defeat {amount} Forge Golems in combat to earn the Key of Embers.

title: Echoes of the Shard
description: The Shard of Corruption resonates near the Crucible. Pyralis offers an alternate path — feed the Shard to the Crucible's heart.

title: Slag Beast Bounty
description: The slag beasts are growing bolder near Forge Keep. Kill {amount} to thin their numbers.

title: The Ember Sprite Menace
description: Ember sprites have been setting fires near Ashfen Village. Kill {amount} before the village burns.

title: Serpents in the Harbor
description: Lava serpents have nested in the harbor caves, threatening the docks. Kill {amount} to clear the shipping lanes.

title: The Lost Patrol
description: A forge guard patrol went missing near the eastern lava fields. Find Sergeant Reld and learn what happened.

title: Forge Initiation
description: The Acolyte of Pyralis will teach you the secrets of flame — but first, prove your worth. Defeat {amount} enemies in combat.

title: Into the Volcanic Depths
description: Harbor Captain Voss needs intelligence on what lurks below. Descend to the 5th level of the dungeon.

title: The Hermit's Warning
description: Old Soot speaks of a hermit named Valdris who watches the volcano. Find him on the eastern slopes and hear his warning.

title: Medicine for Ashfen
description: Healer Ashara needs {amount} Pyralis Fire Potions to treat burn victims in the village.

title: Sky Predators
description: Storm hawks are terrorizing the rope bridges. Kill {amount} to make travel safe again.

title: Windchime Restoration
description: The sacred windchimes that protect Windhaven have shattered. Collect {amount} Windchime Fragments to restore them.

title: The Sky Pirate
description: Dockmaster Vael says the sky-pirate Captain Windlass knows the island's secrets. Find her on the overworld near Galewick.

title: Trial of the Gale
description: The Tempest Twins at Stormspire will teach you the secrets of the storm — but first, defeat {amount} enemies to prove your worth.

title: The Weathervane's Prophecy
description: A broken oracle called The Weathervane keeps to the sky near Cloudrest. She may hold answers about the Forge Eternal and the gathering of shards.

title: Static in the Air
description: Thunder elementals are destabilizing the rope bridges with their electrical discharge. Kill {amount} to restore safe passage.

title: Clearing the Gales
description: Gale spirits are disrupting the sky-dock wind currents. Kill {amount} so the ships can dock safely.

title: Restless Spirits
description: Cloud wraiths haunt the meditation grounds near Cloudrest. Destroy {amount} so the monks can find peace.

title: Dock Defense
description: Sky raiders keep attacking the Galewick docks. Kill {amount} to discourage future raids.

title: Beneath the Clouds
description: Explore the 3rd level of the dungeon beneath the Storm Archipelago. Something ancient stirs below.

title: Reva's Precision Trial
description: Reva demands surgical precision. Kill exactly {amount} Storm Hawks — no more, no less — to prove your discipline.

title: Milo's Chaos Trial
description: Milo wants chaos! Defeat {amount} of anything that moves. The storm doesn't discriminate, and neither should you.

title: Lightning in a Bottle
description: Grounded Grik needs {amount} Vials of Lightning to power his forge. Buy or find them and bring them back.

title: The Pilgrim's Journey
description: A wandering pilgrim in Cloudrest seeks the wisdom of The Weathervane. Speak with the oracle on his behalf.

title: Wreck of the Stormchaser
description: A sailor is stranded at the crashed airship northwest of the main island. Find her and learn what brought the ship down.

title: The Spreading Bark
description: Rootspeaker Thenna asks you to investigate the overgrowth spreading from the Great Root. Descend into the Rootvault, find what feeds the corruption, and choose whether to destroy or enable Sylvandar's experiment.

title: The Amber Sage's Memory
description: The Amber Sage asks you to collect 4 memory crystals scattered through the Amber Grove. Each holds a truth from before the Shattering.

title: The Necessary Rot
description: Fungal Lord Mycos has given you spore pods to plant at the blight-hearts inside the Rootvault. Spread decomposition to restore the cycle of growth and decay.

title: The Verdant Trial
description: The Amber Sage's final test: destroy {amount} Blight Mothers that feed the overgrowth. Prove you understand that pruning is an act of love.

title: Clear the Clearings
description: Ashwalker Dren needs the vine stranglers cleared from the forest clearings so he can plant fire-resistant trees. Kill {amount} of them.

title: The Shard of Endless Growth
description: Deep within the Rootvault, Sylvandar's grief has crystallized into a Shard of Endless Growth. Claim it — or destroy it. The choice will shape the forest's future.

title: The Living Root's Gift
description: The Root Warden of Roothollow offers to teach you the ancient spell of Entangle — but first you must prove your bond with the forest. Slay {amount} Root Golems to show you understand the balance of growth and pruning.

title: Roots of Memory
description: Elder Varen in Roothollow wants you to speak with the Amber Sage about the Great Tree's accelerating growth. She may know what ancient memory drives the tree's hunger.

title: The Bridge Rot
description: Bridgekeeper Orin has found rot spreading through the southern bridge-roots. Carry the spore sample to Bark Weaver Fen in Roothollow so she can read what it means.

title: The Amber Ward
description: The Grove Keeper in Amber Grove needs a Sylvan Healing Draught to brew an amber ward against the overgrowth. Bring one to her.

title: The Cracking Dome
description: The pressure dome over Abyssport is failing. Collect {amount} Pressure Ward Fragments from the vents outside the city before the dome collapses.

title: The Deep Reading
description: Presskeeper Nym has discovered runes in the Pressure Temple that predate the Shattering. Explore the temple and return with what you find.

title: Trial of the Crushing Deep
description: Thalorax demands you face what lies beneath. Descend into the Pressure Temple, defeat the Abyssal Leviathan at the trial altar, and earn the Key of Depths.

title: Varsa's Choice
description: Tide-Priestess Varsa serves Lirandel but is stranded in the Abyssal Depths. She asks you to carry a message — or help her go deeper. Choose wisely.

title: Wraiths of the Deep
description: Abyssal wraiths are seeping through the pressure wards. Kill {amount} before they breach the inhabited zones.

title: The Fading Names
description: Archivist Sable's archive crystals are going dark, and each one that fails takes a name with it. Recover four from the Archive of Tears.

title: The Eighth Dream
description: Mourner Vel speaks of an eighth dream that existed before the Shattering — one consumed by the other seven. Search the Archive of Tears for evidence of this lost dream called Hope.

title: Umbryn's Silence
description: Umbryn waits in the deepest sanctum of the Archive of Tears. Enter his domain and face the trial of memory — the most emotionally complex challenge yet.

title: Echo of Seraphine
description: Archivist Sable can summon a memory-imprint of Seraphine from thirty years ago. Stand before the Well of Names in The Hollow to hear what the previous Unbound knew.

title: The Eternal Siege
description:
Korrath wants the eastern trenches cleared. The War Wraiths there were Gold Guard once; they fell holding a line that has not moved in thirty years and they are still holding it.
Put down {amount} War Wraiths.

title: The Brothers Three
description: Holt, Marren and Tor swore a blood oath to fight together and never came back from the no-man's land. Find the Brothers Three out in the war fields and learn what became of them.

title: Bellorak's Arena
description:
The Iron Pit runs a card of champions, and the last name on it has held the top of the card for twenty-two years without a single night off.
Go down into the Pit and take an audience with Bellorak.

title: The Iron Ghost's Truth
description: Deserter Quinn speaks of a spirit haunting the Iron Pit — the ghost of Bellorak's first champion. Find the Iron Ghost and learn the truth about the god of war.

title: The Shard of Freedom
description: Zephyrion left a fragment of itself in the Stormspire. Carry it, or break it.

title: The Undrowned Lamp
description:
Brightcoral's spire lamp has burned since before the Shattering, because Thalorax will not let a light go out any more than he lets a drowned man go. Its wick-coral is finally spent, and Lampwright Oleander has fed it for sixty-one years.
Bring her {amount} Lumen Coral.

title: The Ninth Ward
description:
Abyssport keeps its dead standing in a sealed ward, because the reef will not take a dome-salted body and Thalorax will not release one. The coral wardens grown to hold them upright have begun walking out.
Put down {amount} Deep Coral Constructs.

title: The Pressed Woman
description:
Presskeeper Nym holds an impression she cannot develop: a woman who walked to the trench floor thirty years ago, upright, and did not drown. To raise the rest of the image she needs raw trench-pressure, and it only still runs in the leviathan graves.
Descend into the Boneyard Trench.

title: The Air Debt
description:
Every breath under the Abyssport dome is metered, and a debt does not die with the debtor — it sinks onto whoever is standing nearest, which is usually a child. Anglerfish oil is what settles a ledger down here.
Render {amount} Anglerfish Horrors for Diver-Chandler Bexen.

title: The Conscript Runes
description:
Thalorax cuts his claim into everything the sea keeps — the jaws of sharks, the chests of hulks, and the shoulder of a priestess who has been down here eleven years and did not consent to any of it. Four of the same, freely taken, will buy one out.
Cut the runes from {amount} Rune-Scarred Sharks.

title: The Leviathan's Jaw
description:
The Ancient Kelp-Keeper is four hundred and eleven years old and has one question left. There is a jaw in the southern trench a mile across that matches nothing, and the kelp — which grows on everything — will not grow on it.
Go and stand in the Leviathan's Jaw.

title: Brightcoral's First Stone
description:
The reef has a rite for the drowned and none at all for a mother who simply went up. The Coral-Child wants to know what stone you set for somebody who is only gone.
Ask Depth-Warden Silt.

title: The Name She Used Here
description:
Umbryn keeps a file on everyone. Seraphine's was moved out of the Archive of Tears years ago, because people kept reading it, and moved things in Umbryn's domain go to one place.
Search the Forgotten City.

title: The Archive of Small Things
description:
Umbryn only ever kept what hurt, and that is exactly why the weight is killing him. Keeper Mord wants four days on which nothing happened put into the record instead, and is prepared to be laughed at about it.
Collect {amount} Ordinary Days.

title: The Unmourned
description:
A Hollow One is what is left when Umbryn drops a name: a person still walking, with nobody in them. Mourner Vel says putting them down is the only funeral anyone is going to give them.
Lay {amount} Hollow Ones to rest.

title: The Well of Names
description:
The Well in The Hollow was guarded, once, when anyone still came to it. The guards are Echo Knights now and they have not been relieved in four hundred years, and the Well would like somebody to relieve them.
Release {amount} Echo Knights.

title: Borrowed Grief
description:
The Archivist of Dusthaven will take a grief off you for a fee. He has never once explained where he puts it. Grief Elementals have been thickening in the trenches for as long as he has been in business.
Disperse {amount} Grief Elementals.

title: The One Who Stayed Awake
description:
Lorekeeper Iris has been reading the ward-resonances for a decade and has found somebody standing outside the Archive who has been standing there longer than the Archive.
Speak with The Chronicler at the northern ward-circle.

title: The Quota
description:
Surgeon Hask buries the same number of Iron Reckoners every month. Not more. Not fewer. He has eleven years of counts and the variance is smaller than a coin toss, which is not how dying works.
Kill {amount} Glory Hounds and let him see whether the month comes in short.

title: The Oath That Outlived Him
description:
An Iron Reckoner blood oath does not die with the man who swore it — it goes to the nearest kin, and failing kin, the nearest witness. Oathkeeper Sten witnessed the wrong death and inherited a vow to kill a man who has been dead eleven years. The Blood Oath Berserkers on the field are further down the same road.
Release {amount} Blood Oath Berserkers.

title: The Field That Was a Town
description:
The front has washed back and forth across the same forty miles for longer than anyone can count, and Grik says there is a town under it — his town, with streets, and a name he will not say until somebody else has seen it.
Descend into the War Beneath.

title: What Glory Costs
description:
Quartermaster Ives keeps a private ledger of iron issued against iron recovered, and for thirty years more has come back off the field than ever went out. The Iron Golems are made of recovered gear, and when they break they break down into more.
Break {amount} Iron Golems and let him count what comes off them.

title: The Thirty-Year Letter
description:
Letter-Keeper Ionna holds the letters the fallen wrote to be opened afterwards. Most of the addressees are dead too. One is thirty-one years old and addressed to a woman who was never in either army, and it has never been delivered because nobody knew where she went.
Carry Corran's letter down into the Iron Pit.

title: The Pit Master's Ledger
description:
The Pit Master publishes the season's casualty odds before the season starts, and he has never once had to pay out long. The Undying are his stock: fighters who kept winning until winning was the only thing left in them.
Put {amount} of the Undying down.

title: The Ledger of Cuttings
description:
Sylva prunes, which makes her the most disliked woman in Roothollow. A Vine Strangler is a cutting nobody took: a grief the god planted and then let run for a century.
Take {amount} Vine Stranglers, and be able to say what you cut.

title: The Child Who Is Becoming
description:
Bark Weaver Fen worked bark for thirty years and now a child she taught to whittle is turning into it. Everyone in Roothollow has already decided how they feel about that. Fen wants one person who has not.
Go and look at Bloom, out by the Great Root, and come back and say honestly what you saw.

title: The Grief Orchard
description:
Sylvandar plants a tree for every death he notices, and he notices most of them. The orchard east of Mossbridge is now larger than the ground can feed, so the trees have begun competing, and the losers come down out of the canopy hunting.
Bring down {amount} Canopy Stalkers.

title: The Ravine Closes
description:
The ravine opened on the night of the Shattering and the Ravine Watcher has measured it every year since. It is narrowing — one finger a year, without fail, which is not how geology behaves. Something below is laying the courses.
Descend to the second level of the Rootvault and look at the walls.

title: The Standing Stones
description:
Wolfie says the alpha was a symptom. Something in the ravine draws the wolves to the old markers, and he has never once got close enough to look at it without teeth in the way.
Find Eldorf the Ranger on the moor and ask what he has seen at the stones.

title: The Slag Lists
description:
Sailor Tam has been comparing the crew manifests out of Cinderport against the ones that come back from the slag mines, and the arithmetic is wrong in a way that only works if nobody who goes in is ever recorded as a person again.
Find Dross out on the ash plains and hear it from something that ran.
